scope: LocalPrecision.inverse_jet_stability assumes E*F=1 and input ideal membership. Concrete finite-buffer congruence equivalence and complete Hermite precision remain separate.
statement: For the actual integral denominator inverse, if an invertible approximation E is congruent to D modulo the jet ideal generated by2^p and X^q, its inverse F is congruent to the actual inverse modulo that same ideal.
